copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 channels 分支里的 Webex 适配器复制到 src/channels/,在 barrel 里追加一行注册 import,安装 @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0,然后构建并跑注册测试。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Cisco Webex 渠道时,它会接管,执行复制适配器、注册、安装依赖、构建与测试等步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Webex 渠道
say.note: 复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建测试
红表示 barrel import 或依赖漂移

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Webex adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends a registration import to the barrel, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Cisco Webex as a channel in NanoClaw; it copies the adapter, registers it, installs the package, then builds and runs the registration test.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel integration to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers it, installs deps, builds and tests
Red means barrel import or dependency drift

say_en.text: Use /manage-channels to wire this Webex channel to an agent group
say_en.note: Wires the channel to a chosen agent group
